test_title: PYST 23: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 16 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with an appropriate option.

I believe that we are ________ responsible for our choices.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3' **i.e. **'Solely'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **sentence needs** a word that reflects the extent of the responsibility.
 
• **Solely: **This adverb means only and nothing more.
 
• When we say that we are "solely responsible" for something, it **means** we are the only ones responsible.
 
• In the **context of the sentence,** this is the best fit because it effectively conveys that the responsibility for our choices lies completely with us.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is:* I believe that we are solely responsible for our choices. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Profusely: **This adverb is used to describe doing something in great quantity or abundantly. In this context, it doesn't make sense to be "profusely responsible."
 
• **Durably: **This adverb means in a manner that withstands wear, pressure, or damage. It doesn't fit in this context as responsibility is not something that can be "durable."
 
• **Ordinarily: **This adverb means normally or usually. "Ordinarily responsible" doesn't make sense in this context because it would imply that we're only responsible under normal conditions, which isn't the point the sentence is trying to make.
